source.scope: Matched baseline/candidate instrumented exports on one Windows runner. Each action starts a new process. Retained and Load use the same r1-baseline-fresh profile after real manual Save and Autosave. Verbose engine logging is enabled equally to identify shutdown resources. OS caches are not cleared.

passage.scope: Four matched first-new-passage transitions per variant after 31 real encountered source captions. Destination absent from both runtime and strict semantic caches; same day parse already available. Native caption Enter selects the existing pass route. First correct drawing uses frame_post_draw; usable requires natural complete reveal and input readiness. One additional elapsed second is observed after usability. Cache inspection, full state checks, PNG encoding and hashes are outside timed intervals. Polling and lightweight observer wrappers remain inside; costs are inclusive and overlap. Missing synchronous counter means zero calls. Same runner and identical overlay, AB/BA/AB/BA; no cold OS-cache claim or device-wide guarantee. Nested destination PNGs require visual review in addition to integrity checks.
